content: Default-exclusion evidence: Duplicati ships built-in OS-specific filter groups (SystemFiles, OperatingSystem, CacheFiles, TemporaryFiles, Applications) chosen via DefaultExcludes; Veeam always excludes temp, Recycle Bin, pagefile, hibernate, VSS metadata, EFS. restic offers opt-in cache exclusion via CACHEDIR.TAG (--exclude-caches) and --exclude-if-present. Kopia canonical ignore examples are dist/, node_modules/, public/. Backblaze/CrashPlan default lists could not be fetched (bot-blocked); NAS-specific junk (Synology @eaDir thumbnails) is documented in Duplicati's filter use cases. Confirmed user expectation: curated junk suggestions exist in mature tools, always explicit and reviewable, never silent.
